definition.function: Illustrative liquid/liquid shell-and-tube heat exchanger with two separate circuits: the tube-side stream enters at tube_inlet on the front head and leaves at tube_outlet on the rear head (single tube pass); the shell-side stream enters at shell_inlet and leaves at shell_outlet on the shell body; the circuits do not mix. Heat duty, flows, temperatures, pressures, fluids and thermal or mechanical design are unknown and not verified.

asm-hx101-dimensions.description: Illustrative exchanger size for a small DN50 prototype skid: 1.6 m straight shell between the tubesheets, 0.3 m shell outside diameter, 0.8 m centreline height above the floor and 0.2 m from each tubesheet face to its head tangent line by default. Chosen only to demonstrate composition; no heat-transfer area, duty, pressure, temperature, material or design code is implied or verified.

asm-hx101-nozzles.description: Four DN50 nozzles with flange faces 150 mm beyond the head apex or shell surface: tube_inlet on the front head apex facing -x and tube_outlet on the rear head apex facing +x (single tube pass), shell_inlet on the bottom of the shell and shell_outlet on top, each shell_nozzle_offset (0.22 m by default) from the rear and front tubesheet respectively. Orientations and offsets are illustrative, not a nozzle schedule; liquid service comes from the request; duty and ratings are unknown.

rcp-appearance.description: Colours, metalness and roughness are appearance-only and assert no material of construction.

rcp-flange-dn50-like.description: DN50 nozzle flange proportions shared with the skid recipes (OD 150 mm, 18 mm thick, four 18 mm holes on a 120 mm circle). No rating or standard selected.

rcp-hx101-arrangement.description: General external arrangement only, from public text sources: one stream in the tubes and one in the shell kept apart by the tubesheets (Alfa Laval shell-and-tube product page; engineersedge.com shell-and-tube review), two stationary tubesheets with a head at each end in the fixed-tubesheet design (Bendel fabrication page), TEMA naming of front head, shell and rear head (wermac.org), and tube nozzles on opposite heads for a single pass with shell nozzles on the shell body (engineersedge.com). Tubes, baffles, tie rods and pass partitions are internal and not modelled. No vendor geometry, drawing or dimension is copied and no TEMA type designation is claimed.

rcp-hx101-heads.description: Each bonnet is a straight barrel at shell radius closed by a semi-elliptical head of depth half the shell radius, approximated by a revolved polygon with five points per quadrant. The head type of a real unit (bonnet or channel with removable cover) is not selected.

rcp-hx101-joints.description: Each 30 mm tubesheet is clamped between a 24 mm shell flange and a 24 mm bonnet flange by twelve studs on a circle 24 mm outside the shell radius; flange outer radius is the shell radius plus 45 mm. Not a flange design, gasket, bolt specification or rating.

rcp-hx101-saddles.description: Two fabricated saddles at 25 % of the shell length either side of centre, each with a web, two stiffeners, a base plate and four anchor bolts. Saddle count, positions and fixed or sliding ends are not sourced; not a support design.

constraints.message: the bottom shell nozzle flange face needs at least 150 mm above the floor
each bonnet needs at least 20 mm of straight barrel beyond its 24 mm flange
shell nozzles need 10 mm clear of the shell flanges
shell inlet and shell outlet need at least 200 mm between them along the shell
the bottom shell inlet must clear the front saddle by 10 mm
the bottom shell inlet must clear the rear saddle by 10 mm

geometry.description: A horizontal cylindrical shell between two tubesheets, each clamped between a shell flange and a bonnet flange, a bonnet head at each end with an axial DN50 tube nozzle on its apex (tube_inlet at the front, tube_outlet at the rear), a bottom DN50 shell inlet near the rear tubesheet, a top DN50 shell outlet near the front tubesheet and two saddles, composed only from the existing part vocabulary (cylinder, revolve, prism, box, instances, flanged_nozzle, bolting, bolt). Tubes, baffles, tie rods and other internals are not modelled. Illustrative geometry with explicit ports, parameters and assumptions; not an exchanger design.
geometry.frame: Local frame: origin on the floor below the shell centre, shell axis along +x (front head at -x, rear head at +x), +z up. Expression lengths are millimetres; parameters are declared in metres.
geometry.title: Horizontal shell-and-tube heat exchanger, fixed tubesheets, single tube pass (illustrative)

definition.name: Horizontal shell-and-tube heat exchanger (fixed tubesheets, single tube pass)
unknowns: Heat duty, flow rates, inlet and outlet temperatures, pressures and fluid identities on both sides are unspecified.
Tube count, diameter, length and layout, number of tube passes (single pass is a modelling choice), baffle type and spacing and heat-transfer area are not designed or verified.
Materials of construction, design code, flange ratings, TEMA type designation and the need for a shell expansion joint are not selected or verified.
Nozzle orientations and positions and the saddle arrangement are illustrative; vents, drains and instrument connections are not modelled.
Which stream is assigned to the tube side or the shell side is a modelling choice, not a verified process decision.
